messages.subject: Re: Duplicate-looking accounts
messages.body:
Which owner ID will Support get if it opens the shared entry? Both registrations already have verified IDs.

The same spelling always gets the same key. Other spellings can get it too. Audit will still need the source records for the export.

messages.subject: Re: Duplicate-looking accounts
messages.body:
Require a match against each retained registration before the export opens. The diagnostic can locate a bucket.

Audit still has the pre-merge lengths, scripts and a limited byte comparison. Those came from the source records.
